tools.name: get_index_benchmarks
tools.description:
The Attic Standard price indexes for AI inference: every published index at the week the site shows.

Six families: Modality (text, multimodal, image, video, audio, voice, embeddings), Channel (model developers, cloud marketplaces, inference platforms, neoclouds), Tier (flagship, core, compact), License (open weights, restricted weights, proprietary), Origin (United States, China) and Use case (reasoning, coding).

For each index and direction (input, cached input, output) it returns the benchmark level (May 2026 = 100) with week, month and vs-base changes, the spot price (median, p25, p75 in dollars) with its own week, month and vs-base changes, and coverage counts with the May 2026 basket size, flagged where the basket has changed materially since the base.

Free: fully public, the same figures atticstandard.com publishes. Token prices are per 1,000 tokens; other modalities use their own unit (per image, per second, per minute, per 1,000 characters).

Examples:
  - "Where is text inference priced this week?" -> index_code="TXT"
  - "Compare the four channels" -> index_category="Channel"
  - "Open-weight versus proprietary" -> index_category="License"

index_code.description: One index, e.g. 'TXT', 'NCL', 'FLG' or the full code 'AIPI TXT GLB'. Omit for all published indexes.

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description:
Weekly history. With index_code: the index series (benchmark level, May 2026 = 100, and the spot price with its 25th and 75th percentiles) for up to 260 weeks; free. With model_name: every vendor's price for that model week by week, showing when each SKU was repriced; Attic Standard MCP PRO.

Token prices are per 1,000 tokens; other modalities use their own unit (per image, per second, per minute, per 1,000 characters).

Examples:
  - "How has the neocloud index moved since May?" -> index_code="NCL"
  - "Has anyone cut the price of DeepSeek V3 this quarter?" -> model_name="DeepSeek V3", weeks=13

index_code.description: Index history, e.g. 'TXT', 'DEV', 'OSS' or 'AIPI TXT GLB'. Free.

model_name.description: Model price history across every vendor that sells it, e.g. 'GPT-4o'. PRO.

vendor.description: With model_name: limit to one vendor. PRO.

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: get_kpis
tools.description:
The nine market KPIs Attic Standard publishes each week.
- Price structure: output premium, caching discount, caching availability
- Price dynamics: repricing activity, repricing depth, post-launch drift
- Competition: multi-vendor spread, first-party premium, marketplace premium

Each KPI returns its value, interquartile range, population, week, month and vs-base changes, and its published definition. Free: fully public, the same figures atticstandard.com publishes.

weeks.description: Weeks of history per KPI (default 1, latest only)

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: get_model_intelligence
tools.description: Six capability and coverage measures drawn from the metadata behind every tracked model: reasoning tier share, long-context saturation, frontier context ceiling, output ceiling spread, training cutoff lag and vendor modality breadth. Read alongside the market KPIs, they explain why models are priced the way they are. Free: fully public, the same figures atticstandard.com publishes.

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: get_index_constituents
tools.description:
What sits inside an index basket this week. Free tier: the composition (SKUs, models and vendors, split by channel, origin, tier and license). Attic Standard MCP PRO: the model-by-model basket with the vendors selling each model.

Examples:
  - "What is in the flagship index?" -> index_code="FLG"
  - "How much of the China index is sold through neoclouds?" -> index_code="CHN"

index_code.description: Index to open, e.g. 'TXT', 'FLG', 'CHN' or 'AIPI TXT GLB'

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: get_market_stats
tools.description: Coverage of the tracked market (active vendors by channel, countries, models, priced SKUs, published indexes) and price distributions split by modality, unit and direction. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstandard.com/mcp) returns vendor names, model names and exact prices. Token prices are per 1,000 tokens; other modalities use their own unit (per image, per second, per minute, per 1,000 characters).

modality.description: Optional modality: Text, Multimodal, Image, Video, Audio, Voice

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: list_vendors
tools.description: Every vendor in the Attic Standard fleet with its channel (model developer, cloud marketplace, inference platform or neocloud), country, region and pricing page. Filter by channel, region or country.

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: search_models
tools.description:
Search every priced SKU by modality, vendor, channel, creator, family, tier, license, origin, reasoning, open weights, direction, maximum price and minimum context window. Cheapest first. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstandard.com/mcp) returns vendor names, model names and exact prices. Token prices are per 1,000 tokens; other modalities use their own unit (per image, per second, per minute, per 1,000 characters).

Examples:
  - "Open-weight text models under $0.0005 per 1,000 output tokens" -> open_source="true", modality="Text", direction="Output", max_price=0.0005
  - "Chinese reasoning models on neoclouds" -> origin="China", reasoning="true", channel="Neocloud"

modality.description: Text, Multimodal, Image, Video, Audio, Voice

creator.description: Model creator (the lab that built the model)

reasoning.description: 'true' for reasoning models only, 'false' to exclude them

max_price.description: Maximum price in the SKU's own unit (per 1,000 tokens for token models)

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: get_model_detail
tools.description: One model in depth: specs (creator, origin, tier, license, context window, output limit, training cutoff, modalities), the Attic Standard indexes it belongs to, and its price at every vendor. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstandard.com/mcp) returns vendor names, model names and exact prices.

model_name.description: Model to look up, e.g. 'GPT-4o', 'Claude Sonnet 4.5', 'Llama 3.3 70B'

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description:
The same model, or a whole family, priced across every vendor that sells it: cheapest and dearest offer, vendor count and spread ratio for each direction, plus each offer with its channel. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstandard.com/mcp) returns vendor names, model names and exact prices. Token prices are per 1,000 tokens; other modalities use their own unit (per image, per second, per minute, per 1,000 characters).

Examples:
  - "Cheapest place to run Llama 3.3 70B" -> model_name="Llama 3.3 70B"
  - "Qwen family output prices" -> model_family="Qwen", direction="Output"

model_family.description: Whole family instead of one model, e.g. 'Llama', 'Qwen'

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.

tools.name: get_vendor_catalog
tools.description: Everything one vendor sells: channel, country, pricing page, model and SKU counts, and the full price list. Free tier returns counts, ranges and redacted samples; Attic Standard MCP PRO ($500/month, https://atticstandard.com/mcp) returns vendor names, model names and exact prices. Token prices are per 1,000 tokens; other modalities use their own unit (per image, per second, per minute, per 1,000 characters).

vendor.description: Vendor name or id, as listed by list_vendors

modality.description: Optional modality: Text, Multimodal, Image, Video, Audio, Voice

_atom_api_key.description: Your Attic Standard MCP PRO key for vendor- and SKU-level data. Omit for the free tier.
